name: bizplug-fitness
description: The fitness & gyms plug-in from BizPlug. Main function: book classes, trials and tours. It works from the business's own published profile, covering classes, memberships and trial passes, and sends requests to the business to confirm. It never takes payment and only shares what the business has published. Provided by BizPlug: https://www.bizplug.ai, info@bizplug.ai.
